edits.name: Gamma
edits.old: An outline becomes a presentable deck in minutes, and for internal updates, project briefings and anything where the deadline beats the design, that's real time back. Two catches. Everything it makes has a family resemblance, so give it your colours and fonts before the whole organisation's decks converge on the same look. And on the individual plans a small team would buy, it trains on your content unless you switch that off in settings, so do that on day one. No charity price, and the pricing page keeps its numbers to itself, so check what you'd pay before you commit.
